verdict.rationale: Retell documents an official MCP server that lets MCP-capable clients such as Cursor, Claude Desktop and Claude Code build and manage voice agents through Retell APIs. The docs list agent tools for create, update, publish, list and fetch versions, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. The separate docs on Retell agents calling remote MCP servers are client-side and were not credited. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and documented setup or auth details and the full tool inventory beyond agent operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use Retell's MCP server to build and manage voice agents from MCP-capable clients like Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Claude Code via Retell APIs.
Retell supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so you can build Retell AI voice agents directly from MCP-capable clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex-style tools, and more).
Agents: create, update, publish, list, and fetch agent versions.
